notes: Priority check (a): all six gaps walked at both ends. Five of six match; →M5 is broken (Mollick assigned at run-the-first-experiment.md:72, absent from learn-from-the-test.md:10). No reverse case anywhere — no echo exists without an assignment (checked by rendering all seven bodies through applyContentFlags and counting each pre-read URL per file in both cuts). Priority check (b): variant fences verified by execution, not by reading — `site/layouts/curriculum.js` applyContentFlags run over all seven bodies for module-slug sets [six-module] and [six minus earn-the-trust]. Six-module cut: →M3 renders trifecta+agentic-loops+OWASP, →M4 renders da Costa, M2's no-module pre-M4 block and M4's Willison callback both suppressed. No-M3 cut: M2 renders `## Pre-reads before Module 4` with agentic loops only, M4 renders the matching Module-2 callback, and a scan of every rendered body for /Module 3|M3|earn-the-trust|lethal-trifecta|owasp|lucasfcosta/ returned zero hits — no dangling reference, no orphaned prework echo. Designing agentic loops: assigned in both cuts, exactly once per build (six-module per-file counts plan-mode 1 / earn-the-trust 1 (echo) / run-the-first-experiment 0). Flag tag pairs balance in every file (open/close counts equal per tag per file). Out-of-lane observations, not scored: (1) the six-module M2→M3 close (plan-mode-done-right.md:89) names the M3 task without a bring-or-scramble stakes line, while the same file's no-M3 branch (L91-93) carries one and every other homework gap in the arc does too — cosmetic asymmetry, logged as the run's single todo. (2) Per-class Quality SHAs on earn-the-trust.md, run-the-first-experiment.md, learn-from-the-test.md and spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md predate a4920c15 and the files' own maintainer blocks say so; re-stamping is the orchestrator's, not this judge's. (3) prework.md's cross_module Quality row still cites a four-file set (@99aeb416) — this run supersedes it at full-arc scope.
